source_ref: Wang YN (2016) PLOS ONE 11(1):e0146050 doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0146050 (Study 1 Participants/Measures; Table 1) and its S1 Dataset (doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0146050.s001, SPSS, no variable or value labels); Wood AM, Linley PA, Maltby J, Baliousis M, Joseph S (2008) J Counseling Psychology 55(3):385-399 doi:10.1037/0022-0167.55.3.385, Authenticity Scale appendix, read from the verbatim reproduction at https://cic.edu/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Authenticity-Scale.pdf and cross-checked against the numbered English reproduction in https://europepmc.org/article/MED/PMC12690361 (Polish AS validation) and https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7838489/ ; IRW processing script data/wang_2016_authenticity_relationship.py. Cached under itemtext/.cache/wang_2016_study1_authalien/.
note: PASS WITH CAVEATS (batch_268). 20 rows = 4 items x 5 resp levels; validate_items.R --table-sets passes both sets (authalien1-4; resp 1-5 exactly), 104 respondents per item. (1) REVERSED ANCHORS -- the one thing that differs from the sibling authliving table, and the reason this note exists. Wang's Measures section says 'All ratings were made using 5-point Likert scales, ranging from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree)', but the four self-alienation columns in the PLOS deposit are stored ALREADY REVERSE-SCORED, so the shipped option_text puts 'strongly agree' at resp=1 and 'strongly disagree' at resp=5 -- the opposite of the administered coding and the opposite of what wang_2016_study1_authliving ships. Evidence (verify_wang_2016_study1_authalien.R, VERDICT: PASS, live data only): every authalien item correlates POSITIVELY with the live self-esteem total (+0.327/+0.466/+0.606/+0.567), a total whose own direction is fixed in-script by all ten se items having positive item-rest r (min +0.338); raw self-alienation ('I feel alienated from myself') must correlate negatively with self-esteem. Corroborated by route 3: summing the live authliving+authalien+authexternal tables per person gives M=42.49 SD=6.19 and r=.61 with the se total (38.34/5.08) against Wang Table 1's published 42.49/6.18/.61/38.34/5.08, and Cronbach's alpha over those 12 stored columns is .809 against the paper's reported .81. The counterfactual 'stored raw' reading (flipping the alienation and external blocks back) gives a total of 36.76 and alpha .705 -- 5.7 points and .10 off the published values. This matches what batches 213/214 already found for wang_2016_study1_power and wang_2016_study1_se, which are likewise stored post-reversal. (2) Administered language: Study 1's 104 Beijing Normal University students completed paper-and-pencil questionnaires and 'All questionnaires were presented in their Chinese versions'. No Chinese wording is recoverable in scope: the only Study 1 deposit file is PLOS s001.sav, which carries NO variable labels and NO value labels (55 columns, every column_names_to_labels entry None except four Zscore() autolabels; variable_value_labels == {}), and there is no questionnaire supplement. Hence the fallback -- English in the base fields, _translated columns empty, language=Chinese, text_source=translated_substitute. (3) Wording: Wood et al. (2008) Self-Alienation items 2, 7, 10 and 12, read from the verbatim scale reproduction at cic.edu (which prints all 12 items and the scoring key 'Total items 2, 7, 10, and 12 for Self-Alienation') and cross-checked item by item against the numbered English reproduction in Kwiatkowska et al., 'A Polish language version of Wood et al.'s multidimensional Authenticity Scale' (PMC12690361, Europe PMC full text). DEVIATION DISCLOSED: the cic.edu reproduction prints item 7 as 'I fell as if I don't know myself very well'; the shipped form reads 'I feel as if', which is what PMC12690361 and PMC9638501 both print -- an obvious source typo, corrected knowingly. Item 10 ships with the quotes around 'real me' (cic.edu and PMC7838489 form; PMC12690361 drops them), matching the already-shipped sibling wang_2016_study3_auth. (4) instructions is blank: the paper reproduces no instruction text, and Wood's canonical 1-7 'does not describe me at all / describes me very well' instruction does not apply to this 5-point agreement administration. resp 2, 3 and 4 have blank option_text because the study labels only the two endpoints. (5) mapping_basis=reconstructed. data/wang_2016_authenticity_relationship.py renames A_aliennation1/A_a2/A_a3/A_a4 -> authalien1..4, a number-preserving rename, so the code names the SUBSCALE at the source; the live per-item means and SDs (3.61/1.04, 3.57/1.02, 3.76/0.92, 3.84/0.91) reproduce those four .sav columns to 2dp, which ties the codes to the columns. But the .sav carries no text, so WHICH of AS items 2/7/10/12 each number is comes from the canonical ascending subscale numbering, not from any label, and nothing in the data separates four same-polarity items on one 1-5 range -- item-rest r of .534/.657/.819/.725 does not. Suggestive only, and not counted as verification: authalien3 and authalien4 are the most redundant pair (r=.84), which is what one would expect of the near-synonymous canonical items 10 and 12. Hence verification status PARTIAL. (6) Rights: no reserved right found and no instrument_rights_register.csv row covers the Authenticity Scale. Searches turned up no fee, permission-required, non-commercial, no-derivatives or no-redistribution clause from Wood et al. or APA beyond the article's own copyright notice, which is a notice about the article rather than a term governing the instrument (the PANAS case). Shipped under 'silence is permission'; no ship/ship_with_note register row was written, per the rule that a round may only write block rows. Three sibling tables from this same instrument and paper shipped on the same reasoning in batches 212-214. (7) HEADS-UP FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR, not acted on here and no files touched: wang_2016_study1_authexternal is the same shape as this table (Accepting External Influence is also a reverse-scored block -- its items correlate +0.26..+0.38 with the live se total), so it will need the same flipped anchors; and wang_2016_study3_auth, already shipped, was built from raw Chinese labels via MAP_CN5 rather than from a reverse-scored column, so its ascending anchors are a different case and are not implicated by this finding. (8) RETRY TEST: not applicable -- the table passed and was written. Nothing is pending.
public_note: Item text is shown in English: Wang (2016) administered a Chinese translation of the Authenticity Scale and no Chinese wording is published in the PLOS deposit (the SPSS file carries no variable or value labels), so Wood et al.'s (2008) original English for Self-Alienation items 2, 7, 10 and 12 ships instead. IMPORTANT: these four items are stored ALREADY REVERSE-SCORED in the IRW table, so the response anchors shipped here run the opposite way to the study's stated administration -- resp = 1 is the respondent's 'strongly agree' with the alienation statement and resp = 5 is 'strongly disagree'. That direction is established from the data (all four items correlate +0.33 to +0.61 with the study's self-esteem total, and the three authenticity tables sum to the paper's published total of 42.49, SD 6.18, alpha .81), not assumed. Which of the four canonical items each code authalien1-4 refers to is inferred from the standard subscale numbering and could not be checked against the data -- the block and its direction are verified, but a permutation within the four items would not be detectable.
